title: Create Microsoft To Do tasks from chat with AI
h1: put the next step in your microsoft to do list
description: Turn an agreed next step into a Microsoft To Do task with a bot. Choose the list, title, due date and source link without guessing missing commitments.
keyword: outlook create to do task with ai
keywords: chatgpt create microsoft to do task
ai microsoft to do from notes
answer: a bot can create a microsoft to do task in the list you choose, with a title and optional due date, reminder, importance, notes or linked resources. it looks up the exact list first, so two lists with the same name don't get mixed up. adding a task is an app change, so it needs write access and will not pause under the email sending rule.
og_line: an agreed task, in its chosen list.
what:
you can hand over a concrete commitment from your chat and have it become a task instead of another message to remember. give it the task title and the list name. the bot looks up the right list before creating the task.

optional details can include a source email or document link, categories and low, normal or high importance. dates and reminders need time-zone information. ask the bot to leave uncertain dates out rather than turning a vague intention into a deadline you never agreed.
uses: capture the follow-up you accepted during a supplier call
create a repair task with the original fault-report link in its resources
put an errands item in your personal list without mixing it into work
add a reminder for a paperwork deadline whose date you gave it

routine.message: every weekday at 18:15, collect only the next steps i explicitly accepted in this chat today for quillstone books. show the proposed titles, source links and any dates i actually gave you, then ask before adding them to my "shop follow-ups" microsoft to do list. after approval, create the tasks and report them here. never guess deadlines, assign high importance without instruction or duplicate a task after an uncertain response.
routine.needs: outlook connected, with read and write access to microsoft to do tasks
routine.output:
quillstone books task preview
list: shop follow-ups
title: ask tamsin reed for the revised delivery slip
due: not stated, left unset
source: today's accepted next step in this chat.

steps: connect outlook in **Connected apps** and allow **read and write** for the task bot.
have it look up your to do lists and confirm which one is your follow-ups list.
try one task with a clear title and time zone; ask to preview any due date before it is saved.
check the new task in microsoft to do, then confirm the routine schedule and use **Edit** if your end-of-day time changes.
watch: if two lists share a name, tell the bot which one.
a due date and a reminder are separate optional fields; request both when you need both.
tasks can be created without a deadline, so missing dates should remain missing rather than be invented.

faq.q: does this create an outlook calendar appointment?
faq.a: no. it creates a microsoft to do task in the specified task list. calendar scheduling is a separate job.

faq.q: can the task link back to the email it came from?
faq.a: yes, linked resources can hold an email or document url with a display name. provide the real source link or ask the bot to obtain it before creating the task.
